Imago — Unified CLI & AI MCP Server for cloud images

Usage:
  imago [command]

Available Commands:
  aegis       Accept Aegis product-input manifests (aegis.p01.product-input.v1) and emit product results (imago.p01.product-result.v1)
  apply       In-place live host / SSH provisioning (imageless execution)
  audit       Execute repository health audit script
  boot        Generate microVM direct kernel boot command
  build       Build locally with Packer; other backends refuse execution
  cloud-init  Generate hardened cloud-init configuration
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  epics       Inspect tracked architectural and operational recurring epics
  flavors     Inspect and query the 44-flavor catalog
  help        Help about any command
  kernel      Validate the Aegis kernel requirement and verify nucleus kernel artifacts
  lint        Run specialized static analyzers and linters
  manifest    Inspect and validate versions.json
  mcp         Start the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (stdio or streamable-HTTP)
  milestones  Inspect release milestones
  plan        Validate and route the tracked planning graph (planning/plan.json)
  standards   Inspect machine-verifiable CIS and BSI hardening standards

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for imago

Use "imago [command] --help" for more information about a command.
